{{Quote|He was the Padawan of a Knight named Kin-Ya Dosun, who was also a Gungan.|Seenlu Kir|<ref name="TKAAG" />}}
'''Kin-Ya Dosun''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Dosun [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Kosa-Yin Hadu]], a fellow Gungan. The pair disappeared<ref name="TKAAG" /> around [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]<ref name="note">According to the ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'', the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'' campaign]] begins in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], and ''[[Almas, Sweet Almas: The Kaluthin Are Always Greener|The Kaluthin Are Always Greener]]'' states that [[Kosa-Yin Hadu]] and Dosun disappeared two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events portrayed in the scenario.</ref> while on a mission from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Hadu later emerged<ref name="TKAAG" /> about [[31 BBY/Legends|two years later]]<ref name="note" /> as a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], prompting the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Seenlu Kir]] to investigate the nature of the Gungans' mission to discover where Hadu and Dosun had been lost. However, her inquiries were unsuccessful, and she was unable to learn anything new about their disappearance.<ref name="TKAAG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kin-Ya Dosun was mentioned in ''[[Almas, Sweet Almas: The Kaluthin Are Always Greener|The Kaluthin Are Always Greener]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] supplement that was written by [[Adam Burns]] and released in [[2002]]. It was the first adventure in the [[Almas, Sweet Almas trilogy|''Almas, Sweet Almas'' trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'' campaign]].<ref name="TKAAG" />
